title: Matthew Chapter 24 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Matthew chapter 24 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Matthew Chapter 24 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Matthew Chapter 24.

questions.question: In Matthew 24, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Jesus speaks about not leaving one stone upon another in the temple
The disciples ask Jesus about the sign of His coming and the end of the world
Jesus warns about many coming in His name, saying they are Christ
Jesus tells those in Judaea to flee into the mountains
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus speaks about not leaving one stone upon another in the temple
questions.explanation: This event is described in Matthew 24:2, which appears earliest among these options.

questions.question: What did the disciples come to Jesus to show Him when He departed from the temple?
questions.correctAnswer: The buildings of the temple
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:1 states the disciples came to Jesus to show Him the buildings of the temple.

questions.question: What did Jesus say would happen to the stones of the temple?
options: There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down
questions.correctAnswer: There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down
questions.explanation: Jesus clearly states this in Matthew 24:2.

questions.question: Where was Jesus sitting when the disciples asked Him about the sign of His coming and the end of the world?
questions.correctAnswer: Upon the mount of Olives
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:3 states Jesus sat upon the mount of Olives when questioned by the disciples.

questions.question: What is Jesus's first instruction when answering the disciples' questions?
options: Take heed that no man deceive you
questions.correctAnswer: Take heed that no man deceive you
questions.explanation: Jesus begins His answer with this warning in Matthew 24:4.

questions.question: Who does Jesus say will come in His name and deceive many?
options: Many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ
questions.correctAnswer: Many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:5 states that many will come in Jesus’s name, claiming to be Christ, and deceive many.

questions.question: What are some of the events Jesus says will occur before the end, according to Matthew 24?
options: Wars, rumours of wars, famines, pestilences, and earthquakes
questions.correctAnswer: Wars, rumours of wars, famines, pestilences, and earthquakes
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:6-7 lists these events as occurring before the end.

questions.question: How does Jesus describe these events such as wars and famines?
options: All these are the beginning of sorrows
questions.correctAnswer: All these are the beginning of sorrows
questions.explanation: Jesus calls these events the beginning of sorrows in Matthew 24:8.

questions.question: What will happen to Jesus’ followers according to Matthew 24:9?
options: They shall be delivered up to be afflicted and killed, and hated of all nations for His name's sake
They will be honored by all nations
They will be hidden from danger
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be delivered up to be afflicted and killed, and hated of all nations for His name's sake
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:9 describes persecution and hatred against Jesus’ followers.

questions.question: What will cause the love of many to wax cold, according to Jesus?
options: Because there will be too much peace
Because the temple will be rebuilt
questions.correctAnswer: Because iniquity shall abound
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:12 states that the abundance of iniquity will cause love to grow cold.

questions.question: What will happen after the gospel of the kingdom is preached in all the world?
options: Then the temple will be rebuilt
questions.correctAnswer: Then shall the end come
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:14 clearly states that after the gospel is preached worldwide, the end will come.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus tells those in Judaea to flee into the mountains when they see the abomination of desolation.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:16 instructs those in Judaea to flee into the mountains upon seeing the abomination of desolation.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus warns that many false prophets will rise and deceive many.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:11 states that many false prophets will rise and deceive many.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus says that after the end comes, the love of many will grow stronger.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:12 indicates the love of many will wax cold due to iniquity, not grow stronger.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus commands those on the housetop to come down and gather their belongings before fleeing.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:17 instructs that the one on the housetop should not come down to take anything out of the house.

medium.title: Matthew Chapter 24 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Matthew Chapter 24 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Matthew 24:18, what is a person in the field instructed not to do during the flight?
options: Return back to take his clothes
questions.correctAnswer: Return back to take his clothes
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:18 commands that neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes, emphasizing urgent flight without delay.

questions.question: What does Matthew 24:22 promise will happen if the days of tribulation are not shortened as mentioned in Matthew 24:21?
questions.correctAnswer: No flesh would be saved
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:22 states that except those days should be shortened, no flesh should be saved, linking the command in verse 21 about the great tribulation to the necessity for those days to be shortened.

questions.question: According to Matthew 24:20, what are believers instructed to pray that their flight will not be during?
options: Rainy season or the new moon
questions.correctAnswer: Winter or the sabbath day
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:20 instructs believers to pray that their flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day, highlighting practical concerns for timing.

questions.question: How do Matthew 24:23 and 24 relate in warning believers about false claims of Christ's presence?
options: Verse 23 warns not to believe anyone claiming Christ is here or there; verse 24 explains false Christs and prophets will perform signs to deceive even the elect
Verse 23 encourages believers to seek Christ in the desert; verse 24 says signs will confirm their search
Verse 23 commands believers to follow any signs; verse 24 promises protection from deception
Verse 23 speaks about the end times; verse 24 speaks about the beginning
questions.correctAnswer: Verse 23 warns not to believe anyone claiming Christ is here or there; verse 24 explains false Christs and prophets will perform signs to deceive even the elect
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:23 instructs not to believe claims that Christ is here or there, while 24 warns that false Christs and prophets will arise showing great signs to deceive even the elect.

questions.question: What does Matthew 24:29 say will happen immediately after the tribulation of those days?
options: The sun will be darkened, the moon will not give light, stars will fall, and heavenly powers will be shaken
The earth will open and swallow the wicked
The seas will turn to blood
The mountains will move from their places
questions.correctAnswer: The sun will be darkened, the moon will not give light, stars will fall, and heavenly powers will be shaken
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:29 specifically describes that immediately after the tribulation, cosmic disturbances will occur including darkened sun and moon, falling stars, and shaken powers of heaven.

questions.question: According to Matthew 24:30, what will happen when the sign of the Son of man appears in heaven?
options: All the tribes of the earth will mourn and see the Son of man coming in clouds with power and glory
The earth will rejoice and the wicked will be destroyed
The apostles will gather in Jerusalem
The gospel will be preached to all nations
questions.correctAnswer: All the tribes of the earth will mourn and see the Son of man coming in clouds with power and glory
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:30 states that when the Son of man’s sign appears, all tribes will mourn and see Him coming in clouds with power and great glory.

questions.question: What does Matthew 24:31 say the Son of man will do with his angels?
options: Send them with a great trumpet sound to gather his elect from the four winds
Send them to judge the nations
Send them to preach the gospel
Send them to protect the temple
questions.correctAnswer: Send them with a great trumpet sound to gather his elect from the four winds
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:31 promises that the Son of man will send angels with a trumpet to gather the elect from all corners of heaven.

questions.question: What lesson does Jesus teach with the fig tree in Matthew 24:32?
options: When its branch is tender and puts forth leaves, summer is near
When the tree bears fruit, the harvest is ready
When the leaves fall, winter is coming
When the fig tree withers, judgment is near
questions.correctAnswer: When its branch is tender and puts forth leaves, summer is near
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:32 uses the fig tree’s budding leaves as a sign that summer is near, teaching believers to recognize signs of the times.

questions.question: According to Matthew 24:33, what should believers understand when they see all these things?
options: Know that it is near, even at the doors
questions.correctAnswer: Know that it is near, even at the doors
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:33 instructs that upon seeing all these signs, believers should know that the event is near, at the very doors.

questions.question: What warning is given in Matthew 24:26 about those who say Christ is in the desert or secret chambers?
questions.correctAnswer: Believe it not
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:26 instructs not to believe claims that Christ is in the desert or secret chambers, warning against deception.

questions.question: What does Matthew 24:28 say about where the eagles will be gathered?
questions.correctAnswer: Wherever the carcase is
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:28 states that eagles will be gathered wherever the carcase is, symbolizing gathering at a place of death or judgment.

questions.question: How does Matthew 24:21 describe the tribulation compared to previous times?
options: Great tribulation such as has not been since the beginning of the world, nor ever shall be
A tribulation similar to that of old
A small trial for the faithful
A time of peace and restoration
questions.correctAnswer: Great tribulation such as has not been since the beginning of the world, nor ever shall be
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:21 describes the tribulation as unparalleled in history, emphasizing its severity and uniqueness.

questions.question: True or False: Matthew 24:34 says that this generation will not pass until all these things be fulfilled.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:34 explicitly states that this generation shall not pass till all these things be fulfilled.

questions.question: True or False: According to Matthew 24:23, it is wise to believe anyone who claims, 'Here is Christ,' or 'There,' to avoid missing his coming.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:23 clearly warns not to believe anyone who claims 'Here is Christ' or 'There,' as false claims will arise.

questions.question: True or False: Matthew 24:20 encourages believers to pray that their flight will be in winter or on the sabbath day for better protection.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:20 instructs believers to pray that their flight be not in winter nor on the sabbath day, implying those times would make escape more difficult.

hard.title: Matthew Chapter 24 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Matthew Chapter 24.

questions.question: According to Matthew 24:35, what will never pass away?
questions.correctAnswer: My words
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:35 states that heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away, emphasizing the eternal nature of Jesus' teachings.

questions.question: Who alone knows the day and hour of the coming of the Son of man according to Matthew 24:36?
questions.correctAnswer: My Father
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:36 clearly states that no one knows the day or hour, not even the angels or the Son, but only the Father knows.

questions.question: Matthew 24:37 compares the coming of the Son of man to which historical period?
questions.correctAnswer: The days of Noe
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:37 uses the analogy of the days of Noe (Noah) to describe the unexpected nature of the Son of man's coming.

questions.question: In Matthew 24:40, what is the fate of the two people in the field?
options: One shall be taken, and the other left
One shall be punished, the other rewarded
questions.correctAnswer: One shall be taken, and the other left
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:40 states that two will be in the field, one taken and the other left, symbolizing the sudden separation at the coming of the Son of man.

questions.question: What warning does Jesus give in Matthew 24:42 regarding the hour of his coming?
options: Watch therefore, for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come
Follow the signs in the sky
questions.correctAnswer: Watch therefore, for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:42 exhorts believers to watch because the exact time of the Lord's coming is unknown.

questions.question: According to Matthew 24:51, what is the punishment for the evil servant who is not ready for his lord's coming?
options: Appoint him his portion with the hypocrites
questions.correctAnswer: Appoint him his portion with the hypocrites
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:51 describes that the lord will cut him asunder and assign him with the hypocrites where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'parousia' in Matthew 24:3 mean?
questions.correctAnswer: Coming
questions.explanation: The Greek word 'parousia' used in Matthew 24:3 refers to 'coming' or 'presence,' often used for the expected arrival of the Messiah.

questions.question: Which literary device is prominently used in Matthew 24:37-39, comparing the days of Noe to the coming of the Son of man?
questions.correctAnswer: Typology
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:37-39 employs typology by using the historical event of Noah's days as a type or foreshadowing of the coming of the Son of man.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage is referenced in Matthew 24:15 regarding the 'abomination of desolation'?
questions.correctAnswer: Daniel 9:27
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:15 directly quotes Daniel 9:27 concerning the 'abomination of desolation' standing in the holy place as a sign.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage echoes the theme of sudden unexpected coming of the Son of man found in Matthew 24:44?
questions.correctAnswer: 1 Thessalonians 5:2
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:2 speaks of the day of the Lord coming as a thief in the night, connecting to the suddenness described in Matthew 24:44.

questions.question: What immediately precedes the statement in Matthew 24:35 about heaven and earth passing away but Jesus' words not passing away?
options: This generation shall not pass, till all be fulfilled
The sign of the Son of man shall appear
The abomination of desolation stands in the holy place
questions.correctAnswer: This generation shall not pass, till all be fulfilled
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:34, preceding verse 35, states that this generation shall not pass till all these things be fulfilled, setting the context for the enduring nature of Jesus' words in 24:35.

questions.question: Which cultural practice is referenced in Matthew 24:38 to illustrate normal life before the flood?
options: Eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage
questions.correctAnswer: Eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:38 describes people eating, drinking, marrying and giving in marriage before the flood, indicating their normalcy and unawareness.

questions.question: In Matthew 24:45, what role is assigned to the faithful and wise servant?
options: Ruler over his household to give them meat in due season
questions.correctAnswer: Ruler over his household to give them meat in due season
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:45 describes the faithful servant as one whom the lord has made ruler over his household to provide food at the proper time.

questions.question: How does Matthew 24:49 describe the behavior of the evil servant who doubts his lord’s coming?
options: Smite his fellowservants and eat and drink with the drunken
questions.correctAnswer: Smite his fellowservants and eat and drink with the drunken
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:49 states that the evil servant begins to mistreat his fellow servants and indulges in reckless living.

questions.question: True or False: Matthew 24:44 teaches that the Son of man will come at a time when people expect Him.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:44 clearly states the Son of man will come at an hour when you think not, emphasizing unexpected timing.

theological.title: Matthew Chapter 24 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Matthew Chapter 24 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Matthew 24:13 teach about salvation?
options: Salvation is assured to those who endure to the end
Salvation depends on immediate repentance only
Salvation is given regardless of one's perseverance
Salvation is only for the physically strong
questions.correctAnswer: Salvation is assured to those who endure to the end
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:13 states, 'But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved,' indicating salvation is linked to perseverance in faith.

questions.question: What doctrine about divine judgment does Matthew 24:51 teach?
options: The unfaithful servant will be severely judged with eternal separation
Judgment is based on social status
Judgment can be escaped by good works alone
The servant will be rewarded despite evil deeds
questions.correctAnswer: The unfaithful servant will be severely judged with eternal separation
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:51 describes the lord cutting the evil servant asunder and appointing him his portion with the hypocrites, indicating harsh judgment and separation.

questions.question: What doctrine regarding the proclamation of the gospel is taught in Matthew 24:14?
options: The gospel will be preached worldwide before the end comes
The gospel is only for Israel
The gospel will cease before the end
The gospel is irrelevant to the end times
questions.correctAnswer: The gospel will be preached worldwide before the end comes
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:14 affirms that 'this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come,' emphasizing global proclamation.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Matthew 24:36 specifically demonstrate?
questions.correctAnswer: Omniscience
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:36 states that no one knows the day or hour except the Father alone, demonstrating God's unique and perfect knowledge, i.e., omniscience.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is highlighted in Matthew 24:22 regarding the shortening of days?
questions.correctAnswer: Mercy
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:22 teaches that days of tribulation will be shortened for the elect's sake, reflecting God's merciful care amidst judgment.

questions.question: How does Matthew 24:29 connect to Old Testament prophetic themes?
options: It echoes apocalyptic imagery found in prophets like Joel and Isaiah
It focuses solely on historical events without prophetic significance
It rejects signs in the heavens
questions.correctAnswer: It echoes apocalyptic imagery found in prophets like Joel and Isaiah
questions.explanation: The cosmic disturbances in Matthew 24:29 are reminiscent of Old Testament apocalyptic prophecies such as Joel 2:30-31 and Isaiah 13:10, linking Jesus’ teaching to earlier prophetic tradition.

questions.question: How does the teaching of the 'abomination of desolation' in Matthew 24:15 prepare for New Testament fulfillment?
options: It anticipates the destruction of Jerusalem and the temple in AD 70
It predicts a literal idol in the temple today
It refers exclusively to Old Testament events
questions.correctAnswer: It anticipates the destruction of Jerusalem and the temple in AD 70
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:15’s reference to Daniel’s prophecy prepares readers for the imminent judgment and temple destruction fulfilled historically in AD 70, linking Jesus’ eschatology to past and future events.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Matthew 24:4 and 24:5 teach about deception and human sin?
options: Deception will increase through false messiahs claiming Christ’s identity
Deception will be minimal in the end times
Only external persecution matters, not deception
Deception is irrelevant to the believer’s endurance
questions.correctAnswer: Deception will increase through false messiahs claiming Christ’s identity
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:4 warns against deception, and verse 5 specifies that many will come claiming to be Christ, showing a doctrine of increased deception and false teaching in the end times.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Matthew 24:40 and 24:41 teach about the suddenness of Christ’s coming?
options: The coming will be sudden and selective, separating individuals unexpectedly
The coming will be gradual and universally visible to all simultaneously
Everyone will be taken at once without distinction
The coming is purely symbolic without literal separation
questions.correctAnswer: The coming will be sudden and selective, separating individuals unexpectedly
questions.explanation: Verses 40 and 41 describe two people engaged in normal activities with one taken and one left, highlighting suddenness and selectivity in Christ’s return.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Matthew 24:23 and 24:24 teach about false Christs and deception?
options: False Christs and prophets will perform signs to deceive even the elect
False Christs are easily exposed and pose no real danger
Deception will cease before the end times
Signs and wonders are always from God
questions.correctAnswer: False Christs and prophets will perform signs to deceive even the elect
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:23-24 warns that false Messiahs and prophets will arise with great signs and wonders, capable of deceiving even the elect, defining the seriousness of deception.

questions.question: Sceptics claim Matthew 24:29-31 teaches only symbolic cosmic events with no real future fulfillment. What does Matthew 24:29-31 actually teach?
options: It teaches literal cosmic disturbances and the visible return of the Son of Man with angels
It teaches purely symbolic events with no physical reality
It denies the Son of Man’s return
It predicts only spiritual renewal on earth
questions.correctAnswer: It teaches literal cosmic disturbances and the visible return of the Son of Man with angels
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:29-31 describes actual cosmic disruptions and the Son of Man appearing with power and angels, indicating real future events, not mere symbols.

questions.question: What doctrine about human sin and its consequences is taught in Matthew 24:12?
options: Iniquity will abound causing the love of many to grow cold
Sin will be eradicated before the end times
Love will increase regardless of sin
Iniquity has no effect on believers
questions.correctAnswer: Iniquity will abound causing the love of many to grow cold
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:12 explicitly states that because iniquity shall abound, the love of many will wax cold, teaching about the moral decline preceding the end.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Matthew 24:35 specifically demonstrate?
questions.correctAnswer: Immutability
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:35 states 'Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away,' highlighting the unchanging and eternal nature of God's word.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Matthew 24:42 and 24:44 teach about Christian sanctification?
options: Believers must watch and be ready because the timing of Christ’s return is unknown
Believers can be complacent since the timing is unknown
Readiness is unnecessary as Christ’s coming is symbolic
Only pastors must watch, not all believers
questions.correctAnswer: Believers must watch and be ready because the timing of Christ’s return is unknown
questions.explanation: Verses 42 and 44 emphasize watchfulness and readiness due to the unknown hour, teaching a doctrine of ongoing vigilance in the believer’s life.

questions.question: How does Matthew 24:32-33 use the fig tree parable to connect to biblical eschatology?
options: It teaches discernment of end-time signs indicating the nearness of Christ’s return
It denies any signs before the end
It refers only to agricultural cycles
It claims the generation will not see any fulfillment
questions.correctAnswer: It teaches discernment of end-time signs indicating the nearness of Christ’s return
questions.explanation: The fig tree’s budding in Matthew 24:32-33 is a metaphor for recognizing signs of the times, connecting Jesus’ teaching to the anticipation of the eschatological climax.
